[EN] We're ramping up our preparations against the argons. Naturally, we need your help.

There's several akalath overseers at the {@Rgn:49004}.

Take them out.
[ES] Estamos intensificando nuestros preparativos contra los argon. Naturalmente, necesitamos tu ayuda.

Hay varios akalath overseers en el {@Rgn:49004}.

Acaba con ellos.

[EN] Excellent work. I'll report the portal's status to high command.

Get a bit of rest if you can. You've earned it.
[ES] Excelente trabajo. Informaré del estado del portal al alto mando.

Descansa un poco si puedes. Te lo has ganado.
